body_markdown:
As defense networks evolve, modem modernization is key to secure, flexible multi-orbit SATCOM. Gilat’s approach combines software-defined capabilities, standards-based interoperability and 5G NTN readiness to support the next generation of defense communications.


Read the White Paper here:[Modem Technology Modernization for Mission-Critical SATCOM](https://www.gilat.com/wp-content/uploads/Gilat-White-Paper-Modem-Technology-Modernization.pdf)
